actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/git.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/git.purpose: Inspect or change Git repository state.

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@tools/agent.bind: Resolve the active host delegation capability at invocation time. Require availability, user authorization where applicable, bounded context and declared ownership. Wait for the returned evidence before consuming it.
@tools/agent.purpose: Dispatch bounded work or independent review to a separate agent and receive its result through the active session.

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/print.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/print.purpose: Present text and artifacts in the conversation using the host rendering capabilities.

claude.via: the session's file and render hand-off, which displays an image or an HTML page in the conversation and falls back to the path or the URL

openai.via: the absolute path or the URL printed into the conversation, with the image inline where the client renders one

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@tools/websearch.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/websearch.purpose: Read public web pages to close one named gap in the evidence; results are references with URLs, never authority.

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/be.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/be.purpose: The explicitly bound backend checkout; unavailable when the project has no backend role.

@workspaces/context.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/context.purpose: Supporting reference files for a request.

@workspaces/decisions.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/knowledge.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/knowledge.purpose: Knowledge published by the selected skill runtime.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

criteria.stopWhen: Stop done only when every criterion passes. After two failed feedback rounds, or when authority or capability remains unavailable, return mismatch or blocked with the latest concrete defects and accepted partial artifacts; publish no decision.

purpose: Select one architecture against observed source, business constraints, materially different alternatives, compatibility evidence and an independent critique.

request.description: Supply the objective, fixed constraints, tradeoff axes, requested alternative count and selection policy in inputs.prompts. Bind any business authority or prior decision as input files and supporting source evidence as context files. Missing fixed constraints or authority required to decide must be clarified.
request.title: architecture.decide request

response.description: A done response contains the observed current state, selected stack model, decision receipt and answered independent critique. A blocked response publishes no decision.
response.title: architecture.decide response

scope: Read-only analysis of bound source and context. Produces decision artifacts and an approved decision record; it does not modify product source, start services, deploy, or claim implementation or UAT success.

calls.purpose: Read the request and its exact declared evidence.

steps.instruction: Read the request and declared files. Separate objective, fixed constraints, preferences, assumptions, tradeoff axes, alternative count and selection policy. Bind the current business authority when supplied. Ask for missing fixed intent or approval-dependent choice before analysis.
produces: Frozen decision frame and explicit clarification needs.

reads.when: when an input file is declared
when a context file is declared

calls.purpose: Read bound backend source and configuration.
Verify the observed backend head without changing repository state.

steps.instruction: Inspect backend manifests, configuration, deployment boundaries, stores and source head before proposing. Record only observed components and bind every observation to the frozen head.

reads.when: for each source path needed to inventory the system

calls.purpose: Verify one named compatibility gap against primary documentation.
calls.when: only when bound evidence cannot close that gap

calls.purpose: Persist the selected stack model and evidence verdicts.

steps.instruction: Generate the requested number of materially different alternatives, score each on every frozen axis, apply the declared selection policy, then deepen one selected design. Do not treat incumbency as authority. Declare boundaries, stores and every committed write operation, and verify compatibility on all five mandatory axes.

reads.when: when a pattern is explicitly bound

writes.when: after one viable alternative is selected

calls.purpose: Dispatch one fresh bounded reviewer with only the frozen objective, axes, current state and selected stack model.
Retain the independent critique and resolution record.

steps.instruction: Give a fresh reviewer only the frozen objective, axes, current-state evidence and stack model. Require source-grounded attacks, a materially different alternative and explicit uncertainty. Revise only failed model sections, preserve the critique and record how every finding was resolved.

calls.purpose: Write accepted artifacts and the response record.
Run scripts/validate_operator.py for this bundle and records.
Present the accepted decision and evidence limits.

steps.instruction: Write the decision receipt, typed response and approved decision record from the accepted artifacts. The receipt names contracts and declared operation writers but does not claim implementation, deployment, quality or UAT success.

writes.when: only after all criteria pass and the selection policy permits publication

validate.failurePolicy: Record the concrete failed criterion and evidence. Revise only the affected observation, alternative, stack-model section or critique answer, then reassess; never rerun unchanged analysis or publish a failing decision.

review.instruction: Verify current-state records the bound backend head and source evidence before any proposal or selection was written.

Verify exactly one alternative is selected; every boundary owns named stores or explicitly owns none; every store has one accountable owner; shared writers are justified; and every committed write is declared once with writer, transport, stores, transaction boundary, idempotency, migrations and business dimensions.
Verify every retained component has evidence for runtime version, deployable unit, communication failure, datastore ownership, and backup and restore. Existing use alone is not justification.

Verify a fresh independent critique attacks the selected design and a materially different alternative on the frozen axes, names uncertainties, and every adverse finding is answered or the response remains mismatch.
